title_o: Further Evidence That Repeated Checking Leads to Reduced Memory Confidence, Vividness and Detail: New Evidence That Repeated Object Exposure Also Results in Memory Distrust

replications.journal: Journal of Behavior Therapy and Experimental Psychiatry
replications.quote: we consistently replicated the increase in memory distrust across repeated trials that is typically found with the stove-checking task

effect.name: Memory distrust after repeated object use without checking
